name: UK weather warnings
summary: Met Office lists no weather warnings at 11:40 UK on 17 Nov after the morning's yellow snow warnings lapsed
state: The Met Office warnings feed listed no yellow, amber or red warnings at 11:40 UK on 17 Nov, after seven yellow snow warnings covering southern Scotland, northern England and the Midlands earlier that day had lapsed (Met Office). With no warnings in force, the level returns to Normal.
for_you: Check the Met Office forecast and warnings before travelling, as cold weather continues and new warnings can be issued at short notice.
why: Met Office warnings are the official signal for disruption to travel, power and safety in the UK.
drivers: Storms, heavy rain, snow and ice, heat, fog, thunderstorms.

rubric.watch: Widespread yellow or any amber warning in force.
rubric.normal: No warnings, or only localised yellow warnings.
